chunks: From him, from Ibn Mahbub, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام.
That Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام ruled accordingly and said: “She is to be flogged eighty lashes.”

key_terms.أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amir al-Mu'minin, the title of Imam Ali عليه السلام in this report
key_terms.بِذَٰلِكَ: accordingly; with that judgment previously referred to
key_terms.ثَمَانِينَ: eighty, specifying the number of lashes
key_terms.قَضَى: issued a legal judgment or ruling

ai.seo_question: What punishment did Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام prescribe in this ruling?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal judgment from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام transmitted through Imam Abu Abdillah عليه السلام. It establishes a hadd punishment of eighty lashes in the case referred to by the preceding context of the chapter on the legal limits of zina.
